notes: Golden question set for the Northwind Payments corpus. `type` records what kind of retrieval the question stresses: lexical questions contain a rare exact token that favours BM25, semantic questions are paraphrases that share almost no vocabulary with the source and favour the vector side, multihop questions need passages from two different documents, and unanswerable questions have no support in the corpus at all and must be refused. Keeping the mix explicit is what makes the hybrid-vs-single-retriever comparison meaningful rather than an average over whatever questions happened to get written.
